name: Magenta Gaze
source:
It's the same every night.

Go to the Jazz Club around the corner.

Order the cheapest beer and find a secluded booth to sit in.

Drink.

Drink.

Drink.

That's exactly how Caden expected tonight to go as well.

Until...it didn't.

[From [url=https://jen-flowers.itch.io/magenta-gaze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每一个夜晚都如出一辙。

走进街角那家爵士俱乐部。

点上一杯最便宜的啤酒，找个僻静的卡座独自坐下。

喝。

喝。

一直喝。

凯登原以为，今晚也会一模一样地度过。

直到……意外打破了常规。

[摘自[url=https://jen-flowers.itch.io/magenta-gaze]itch.io[/url]]
